tools.name: xguard_execute
tools.description: Execute an explicit scoped provider operation, or a supported public-source outcome. intent:demo is free. Never infer a mutation from ambiguous text.

tools.name: xguard_secretless_call
tools.description: Call an allowed provider operation with a capability. Enforces scope, call/credit budget and billing before server-side credential injection. Writes require idempotency_key.

tools.name: xguard_preflight
tools.description: Inspect validation, scope and remaining capability budget without reserving, billing or executing. Execution rechecks everything.

tools.name: xguard_quote
tools.description: Inspect XGuard credit pricing for a capability, or obtain a signed x402 quote for a public outcome. Does not execute.

tools.name: xguard_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a ProofRail proof and optionally its bound x402 receipt and result digest. Signature validity does not prove source truth.

tools.name: xguard_discover
tools.description: Find the paid API catalog and buying instructions, plus explicit provider operations and input schemas.

tools.name: xguard_status
tools.description: Read observed execution/MCP metrics and configuration; empty observations do not imply uptime.

tools.name: xguard_get_result
tools.description: Recover a paid public outcome with its payment identifier and original signed quote without execution or another payment.
